races.title: Margaret Long Memorial Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: THEY'RE CHANCERS has made a bright start to his career, winning his sole outing in bumpers and beaten only by a fellow well-bred type at Kelso on his hurdling debut. He is fancied to open his hurdles account with improvement to come, Ar Ais Aris next on the list ahead of Baron du Brizais . THEY'RE CHANCERS (IRE) AR AIS ARIS (IRE) BARON DU BRIZAIS (FR)

races.title: Vesta Wealth Galloping Gains 'Chasing Excellence' Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Every inch a chaser on looks, BOSSMAN JACK was still able to score at the highest level as a novice hurdler and he can go on to even better things now sent over fences. In a field made up of interesting chasing debutants, he is the pick ahead of stablemate Tormund Giantsbane and Kalkbrenner . BOSSMAN JACK TORMUND GIANTSBANE (IRE) KALKBRENNER (IRE)

races.title: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: DOUBLY BLESSED shaped well when beaten only by a good prospect in a Kelso bumper and he could be capable of going one better as he makes his hurdling/stable debut. Throatlash was placed twice over this C&D prior to going chasing and he is the pick for second back over hurdles, while Hurlyburly is also considered. DOUBLY BLESSED (IRE) THROATLASH (IRE) HURLYBURLY (IRE)

races.title: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: TURBOCHARGED confirmed his debut promise when landing a Haydock bumper in impressive fashion in March and looks a novice hurdler to follow this season, as reflected by his inclusion in the Timeform Fifty To Follow. Onyerbike is a dual-winning Irish pointer who must be respected despite making a belated switch to Rules, while newcomer Biscuit Billy catches the eye on paper and also warrants a close look in the betting. TURBOCHARGED (IRE) ONYERBIKE (IRE) BISCUIT BILLY (IRE)

races.title: Settle With Claims Care Consultants Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: COVENTRY took his record to 2-3 since a breathing operation at Ayr last time and he remains on a workable mark on old form. Junior des Mottes made a positive start for this yard when third in the same race and is entitled to finish a bit closer on revised terms, while King Berry is an interesting contender stepping up in trip. COVENTRY (IRE) JUNIOR DES MOTTES (FR) KING BERRY (IRE)

races.title: DJ Bell Celebration Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: The well-connected RAZORS EDGE showed plenty in 2 runs last season with his Newbury form working out particularly well, so he looks the way to go with the prospect of a lot more to come. Doyen Du Bar is the obvious threat off his much lower hurdles rating, while Double Digits should be close to his peak now after a couple of comeback runs. RAZORS EDGE DOYEN DU BAR (IRE) DOUBLE DIGITS

races.title: Home Is Where The Heart Is Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Preference is for RAFFLES WONDER who is potentially well handicapped back over hurdles making only his second start for his new yard. He gets the vote ahead of the lightly-raced Le Fabuleux Buck's on his stable debut, with Bruce Banner and Bollin Skittle completing the shortlist. RAFFLES WONDER (FR) LE FABULEUX BUCK'S (FR) BRUCE BANNER (IRE)

races.title: Light Up A Life Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: MR LINCOLN improved on his hurdles form at the first attempt over fences with a strong-travelling victory at Hexham and he can build on that effort to score again. The biggest threat looks to be Air Apparent , who is also open to progress after his successful chasing debut at Bangor last month. MR LINCOLN AIR APPARENT (IRE) GALIDAM (FR)
